author: Murphh
body:
Welcome to Camp Creeper!  I was inspired by some of my favorite maps (Garden & Village) to make a map set at a summer camp.  There are mini-camps within each quad that players can visit to gather resources such as potions, redstone items, food, and weapons.  There are also some fun areas for parkour, high ropes, canoeing, zip line, etc...

Thanks for considering this map! :)

Dropbox files: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/qhuxd8w9v2hew7p/AAA1b_-Fl4ESFtyTPQ3ORVXca?dl=0
Imgur pictures: http://imgur.com/a/J2Sef#0
